definition.title: The Long Shot
definition.briefing: Bryn has one cannon and a small escort. The quarry tower outranges the unprepared gun. Emplace the cannon on the western firing shelf, protect it from the Ironjaws, and destroy the marked tower.
definition.successText: The tower falls from the prepared shelf. Bryn brings the quarry workers inside the Mountain Keep before the warband returns.
definition.failureText: Bryn or the cannon is lost. Reset and prepare the firing position before engaging the tower.

objectives.text: Emplace at least one unit and destroy the quarry tower. Keep the cannon alive.
Keep Bryn Deepforge alive. The army and zero-resource budget are fixed; reset restores this starting position.

definition.title: Seventy Seconds at Deep Gate
definition.briefing: The quarry crew is inside. Emplace Bryn's line at the narrow Deep Gate and hold the Mountain Keep for seventy-five seconds. Sena has repair timber and a two-soldier reserve.
definition.successText: Sena closes the Deep Gate. Bryn can escort the surveyor through the mines or scout the warband's northern works.
definition.failureText: The Mountain Keep or Bryn falls while the gate is open. Reset the defensive line.

objectives.text: Hold the fortress for 75 seconds. The reinforcement allowance is 2; the listed waves are finite.
Keep Bryn Deepforge alive during the defense.

actions.speaker: Bryn Deepforge
actions.text: The quarry crew is inside. Emplace Bryn's line at the narrow Deep Gate and hold the Mountain Keep for seventy-five seconds. Sena has repair timber and a two-soldier reserve.

actions.speaker: Bryn Deepforge
actions.text: The first Ironjaws are in the gate road. Prepare the firing line.

actions.speaker: Bryn Deepforge
actions.text: A Wardrum is screening their crossbows. Keep the cannon behind the shields.

actions.speaker: Bryn Deepforge
actions.text: The final wave is here. Sena is lowering the gate.
